inicial.meta_descricao: Carbono Consciente: imfundo yemvelo mayelana lokukhishwa kwe carbon, isinyathelo se carbon, amacebo okusimama, izinto ezimangalisayo, lezindaba zemvelo.

hero.titulo: Umkhuba wonke omncane uletha umthwalo omncane kuplanethi
hero.texto: I CARBONO CONSCIENTE KAYISIPHAWU ESILUHLAZA KAPENA UMGOMO OKHATHESI — YINHLANGANISELA YEZINQUMO EZIVAMILEYO, EZIPHINDWAYO NSUKU ZONKE: OKUTSHALA, INDLELA OHAMBA NGAYO, NGESIKHATHI OCIMA UKUKHANYA, LAPHO OPHOSELA UKUNGCOLA.

acordeao.emissao_corpo: Ukukhishwa kwe carbon kukukhishwa kwamagasi afana ne CO₂ emkhathini, ikakhulu ngokutshiswa kwamafutha asendulo, ukugawulwa kwamahlathi, ukukhiqizwa kwemizi-mveliso, langokuthwala kwansukuzonke.
acordeao.clima_corpo: Amagasi avuthayo akha isicaba esibamba ukutshisa emkhathini. Lokhu okukhiswayo kwanda, lomphumela uqina ngokulinganayo — lokhu yikho okuphembelela ukufudumala komhlaba kanye lokuguquka kwesimo sezulu.
acordeao.pegada_corpo: Lisibalo esiphelele samagasi avuthayo akhiqizwayo, ngokuqondileyo kumbe ngokungaqondileyo, ngemisebenzi yomuntu, inkampani, kumbe umkhiqizo empilweni yansukuzonke.
acordeao.neutro_corpo: Ukulingana kwe carbon kufuna ukulinganisa kumbe ukuhlawulela okukhishwayo okwenziwayo. Carbono consciente ibeka phambili izinqumo ezinciphisa umphumela emvelo lingakafikelwa ekucabangeni ngokuhlawulela.

alimentacao.resumo: Izinqumo etafuleni ezinciphisa ukumosheka lokukhishwa kwamagasi

reciclagem.resumo: Hlukanisa, phinda usebenzise, uphe okuseleyo umsebenzi omutsha

fatos.fato1: Isihlahla esikhulileyo sihogela cishe 22 kg zeCO₂ ngomnyaka — yikho ukuphindisela amahlathi kuyindlela eqondile yokulinganisela imiswakalelo.
fatos.fato2: Olwandle luhogela cishe ingxenye eyodwa kwezine zalolo lonke iCO₂ okhiqizwa yisintu nyaka ngayinye, lisebenza njengesilawuli esikhulu sesimo sezulu somhlaba wonke.
fatos.fato3: Ukuphathwa kabutsha kwethani eyodwa yephepha kongela izihlahla ezingaba 17 njalo lamanzi lamandla amanengi uqathaniswa lokukhiqiza iphepha elitsha.
fatos.fato4: Ukuthuthwa kuyimbangela yengxenye eyodwa kwezine yemiswakalelo yeCO₂ yomhlaba wonke ehlobene lamandla — ukutshintshela kuzibhasikili kumbe izithuthi zomphakathi ekuhambeni kwemigwaqo emifitshane kwenza umahluko oqakathekileyo.
fatos.fato5: I-Amazon yindawo yempilo yecishe 10% yakho konke okwaziwayo kobuhlobo bempilo yomhlaba, njalo igcina izigidigidi zethani zekhabhoni ezihlahleni zayo.
fatos.fato6: Amaphaneli alanga ezindlini angehlisa isibopho sekhabhoni sendlu ngamathani eCO₂ ngomnyaka, kuxhomeke emaxubeni amandla endawo.
fatos.fato7: Ukudla okulenyama ebomvu encane kungancipha isibopho sekhabhoni somuntu, ngoba ukufuya izinkomo kuyinye yezinto zokulima eziphumisa imiswakalelo eminengi.
fatos.fato8: Ukuncibilika kweqhwa lolwandle le-Arctic kwehlisa amandla omhlaba wokubuyisela ukukhanya kwelanga emkhathini, kusenza ukufudumala kukhula ngesiqubu — lokhu kuyaziwa ngokuthi impendulo ye-albedo.
fatos.fato9: Izibane ze-LED zisebenzisa amandla angela 80% ancipha kwezibane ezindala njalo zihlala isikhathi eside, zehlisa imiswakalelo lemfucuza.
fatos.fato10: Isivumelwano saseParis, esasayinwa ngamazwe acishe 200, sihlosa ukulinganisela ukufudumala komhlaba ngokungaphansi kakhulu kuka-2°C ngaphezu kwezinga langaphambi kwemisebenzi yezimboni.
fatos.fato11: Cishe ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu yakho konke ukudla okukhiqizwayo emhlabeni kuchithwa — njalo lokhu ukuchitha kodwa kukhiqiza ingxenye enkulu yemiswakalelo yomoya ebanga ukufudumala komhlaba.
fatos.fato12: Amaturbhini omoya wanamuhla angakhiqiza amandla amanengi okondla izinkulungwane zezindlu, kungela ukuphumisa iCO₂ nxa esebenza.
fatos.fato13: Umhlabathi olempilo ugcina ikhabhoni enengi kulazo zonke izihlahla kumbe umkhathi ehlanganisiwe — indlela zokulima zokuvuselela ziyasiza ukugcina ikhabhoni emhlabathini.
fatos.fato14: Amatshe amakorali, loba agubuzele ngaphansi kwe-1% yobhasi lolwandle, asekela cishe 25% yakho konke okwaziwayo kokuphila kolwandle — njalo kulula ukuthi atshintshwe yikufudumala kwamanzi.
fatos.fato15: Ukunciphisa ukuchitha amanzi atshisayo ekhaya (ngokuzekeliso, ukugezela kancane) njalo kuyehlisa imiswakalelo, ngoba ukutshisa amanzi kusebenzisa amandla.
fatos.fato16: Izimoto zombane, lanxa kubalwa ukukhiqizwa kwebhethri, zivamise ukuphumisa iCO₂ encane esikhathini sayo sokusebenza kulezimoto ezitshisa uphetroli, ikakhulu nxa umbane uvela emithombo ehlanzekileyo.
fatos.fato17: Ukwenza umquba ngemfucuza yemvelo ekhaya kuvimbela ukuthi ikhiqize igesi ye-methane endaweni zokulahlwa kwemfucuza — igesi ebanga ukufudumala komhlaba elamandla amanengi kulencane isikhathi iCO₂.
fatos.fato18: Amaqhwa aseGreenland kanye le-Antarctica ndawonye alahlekelwa amathani amakhulu ezigidigidi zeqhwa ngomnyaka eminyakeni yakutshanyana, kunikela ngqo ekukhuphukeni kwamanzi olwandle.

planta.legenda_2: Khathesi sesimila esiqinileko. Imikhuba yakho iyagxila.
planta.legenda_3: Isihlahla esisesibantwaneni, esigcwele amakari. Qhubeka ngendlela le!
planta.legenda_4: Isihlahla esihle esiqhakazile. Imikhuba yakho imangalisa!

globo.sem_dados_territorio: Kakula idatha yokukhishwa kwe CO₂ ngomuntu munye etholakalayo kulesi sifunda.
globo.fonte_estimativa: Isilinganiso se CO₂ yamafutha asendulo ngomuntu munye (Global Carbon Budget / Our World in Data, umnyaka wesisekelo 2024).
globo.aria_interativo: I-globu yokuxhumana yokukhishwa kwe carbon. Donsa ukuthi ijikeleze, skrola ukuthi ukhulise, cofa elizwe ukubona idatha, ucofe kabili ukufaka i-globu kusimo sokukhanyisa.
globo.aria_decorativo: I-globu yokuhlobisa ejikelezayo, etshengisa ubukhulu bomhlaba bephrojekthi ye Carbono Consciente.
